response: Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to technology that aims to simulate human intelligence using machines, particularly computer systems. It involves the development of machine-based systems that can generate outputs such as content, predictions, recommendations, or decisions for a given set of human-defined objectives. AI systems encompass various aspects like models, data representations, knowledge, and processes used to perform tasks (which can be developed using different AI techniques and approaches, and can operate with varying levels of autonomy).
